finalText:
Done. I moved all 12 remaining files over to `db.execute`, three calls each across accounts, support, billing, analytics, catalog, and orders.

One file still calls the old `db.query`: `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`. I left it alone on purpose. Its own header says it's a vendored copy, replaced wholesale on every upgrade, and any local edit there gets silently thrown away. That's also why `lib/db.js` still keeps `query` working alongside `execute` — it's there for cases exactly like this one.
